# Speed Trivia: every question the cleanup removes

6610 questions in 1401 subjects, by category, then subject. Rules: one question per fact; at most 5 facts per subject; a fact only specialists would know is removed (Speed is multiple choice, so it can be harder than Live, but must stay knowable). No subject is left empty. Live = players see it now. Nothing is deleted: a removed question is retired (live) or rejected (waiting), and can be undone.
